status: retrospective descriptive sensitivity; not independent validation

protocol.threshold_selection_rule: Largest complete score threshold whose training a0-plus-thinking tokens do not exceed training uniform tokens; all ties included together; KEEP if even a0 exceeds target, flagged infeasible.
protocol.candidate_resolution_note: Whole-score thresholds are finer than the original one-percentage-point share grid; this sensitivity does not isolate splitting from candidate-resolution changes.
protocol.heldout_rule: Apply frozen training threshold without reading held-out outcomes or costs; evaluate actual gain and cost afterward; never adjust to a held-out budget.
protocol.cost_scope: Generated tokens only; initial answers charged to selective policies, not standalone uniform thinking.
